baseline.note: The MINOS detector paper says the near detector is "located about 1 km from the primary proton beam target"; the 1.04 km value is the baseline quoted in the MINOS sterile search.

total_mass.quote: The 282 plane, 980 metric ton MINOS near detector

summary.plain: The 980-tonne little sister of the MINOS far detector, in a cavern 100 metres below Fermilab about a kilometre from where the neutrino beam is born. It recorded the beam before any neutrinos had changed type.
summary.technical: 0.98 kt magnetised steel-scintillator tracking calorimeter of 282 planes, 1.28 T average fiducial field, in a 100 m deep cavern at Fermilab (225 m.w.e.), about 1 km from the NuMI target.

technology.quote: The two detectors are magnetized steel-scintillator tracking calorimeters.
